title: Ti-VCT Fuel Specifications
introduction:
I choose the rows naming Ti-VCT for this engine section. Their pressure and tank-capacity entries also apply to the named Duratec engine. Fuel pressure is specified with the engine running; the separate EcoBoost/GTDi entry is explicitly limited to its low-pressure side.

The table answers different questions: how much fuel the tank holds, and what delivery pressure should be under the stated condition. The fuel gauge cannot moonlight as a pressure gauge. Keep each value attached to its engine label and printed unit. This page is a specification reference; use the matching engine procedure for safe pressure release, test equipment, connections and interpretation before opening the system or conducting a test.

edits.why: Matching the engine and engine-running condition makes the pressure comparison meaningful. The separate capacity rows describe volume, while the low-pressure-side label belongs specifically to the EcoBoost/GTDi pressure entry. These values alone do not select a replacement part or establish a fault.
